title: anthemis tomentosa subsp. peregrina
intro: Anthemis tomentosa subsp. peregrina, commonly known as Achillea peregrina or common yarrow, is a flowering plant that belongs to the sunflower family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, aiding in digestion, and acting as an antiseptic to prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Achillea peregrina include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant properties, which help in soothing digestive issues, relieving menstrual cramps, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
